podcast.title: Dolby Cafe Breakfast Challenge (August 21, 2018)
podcast.body: On August 21, 2018, in Cliftonville, Margate, the "very skinny" Pete Doherty, who is six feet three inches tall, successfully completed the Dolby Cafe's "eating challenge" breakfast. The meal, served on a toilet-seat-sized plate, included four eggs, four strips of bacon, four sausages, hash browns, onion rings, beans, a quarter-pound hamburger patty, french fries, two thick slices of toast, and bubble and squeak, which he finished in under 20 minutes, earning a free meal and national news coverage. "And he was successful, washing everything down with some coffee, and with a strawberry flavor drink called Yazoo, which sounds lovely."

xref.title: Breakfast Challenge (2018)
xref.body: In 2018, while reportedly clean and sober, Pete Doherty decided to undertake a breakfast challenge. He successfully consumed a massive meal consisting of four eggs, four strips of bacon, four sausages, an order of fries, hash browns, baked beans, mushrooms, "bubble and squeak" (a traditional dish of potato and cabbage fried together), and two thick slices of toast, completing the entire challenge in a swift 19 minutes and 30 seconds. "In 2018, supposedly clean and sober, he got hungry and decided to take on a breakfast challenge, where he ate four eggs, four strips of bacon, four sausages, an order of fries, hashbrowns, baked beans, mushrooms, something called bubble and squeak, which consists of potato and cabbage fried together, and two thick slices of toast."

xref.title: Drug-Fueled Criminality and Animal Cruelty
xref.body: Pete Doherty has a history marked by extensive drug abuse, involvement in "Grand Theft Auto," and at least one hit-and-run incident. He ignited widespread outrage among animal lovers when he was photographed attempting to get his cat to inhale something from a crack pipe.
